scene.prompt: Eye-level straight-on studio product photograph in 4:5 portrait aspect ratio on a pure flat #FFFFFF seamless white background with cutout-on-ground framing, no frame border, no horizon line, and no picture edge. Anchored strictly inside the inset placement box x=9.5% to 39%, y=10% to 82.5%, a clean, physically plausible vertical tiered studio display on three staggered glossy #340A5C purple acrylic risers showcases the three real perfumes drawn exactly as in the attached product sheet, matching every bottle shape, colour, cap, packaging, and label detail: Dolce And Gabbana The Only One Edp Perfume For Women 100ml on the top tier, Hugo Boss Bottled Unlimited Edt Perfume 100ml on the middle tier, and Hawas Elixir Perfume on the lower front tier. All bottles stand upright, unobstructed, and front-facing with sharp focus and slight telephoto compression. Spell every printed word on the products exactly: BOSS, HUGO, UNLIMITED, BOTTER, UNLIMI, DOLCE, GABBANA, The, Only, One, هوس, HAWAS, ELIXIR, 100, ML, EAU, DE, PARFUM, 3.38, FL, الرصاصي. Bright, crisp studio lighting from the upper right creates realistic glass specular highlights and a soft, diffused contact shadow fully contained within x=9.5% to 39%, y=10% to 82.5%. Real materials, no plastic AI sheen, no morphing gimmicks. Keep the entire right and lower canvas pure flat #FFFFFF white and completely empty for later layout: logo (x=71.5%-90.5%, y=7.5%-12%), headline (x=46%-90.5%, y=30.5%-55.5%), and bottom line (x=9.5%-90.5%, y=89%-92.5%). Zero Kapruka logos, headlines, price tags, stickers, watermarks, or any text outside the product bottles.

elements.text: A gift everyone wants, delivered island-wide.

why_it_works: Preserves the asymmetric white-space split, crisp studio product column, and staggered two-tone headline lockup of the reference while adapting cleanly to perfumes.
Over 60% pure flat #FFFFFF negative space keeps the three real perfume bottles and high-contrast Kapruka purple typography uncluttered and readable on mobile.
Visual-to-copy flow leads the eye down the tiered fragrance column, across to the punchy four-line headline, and down to the spoken gifting line anchoring the base.
changes: Replaced the Biscoff jar and stiletto-pitchfork morph entirely with a physically plausible tiered studio display of the three real promoted perfumes (indirect reference rule + playbook anti-morph lesson).
Inset scene.box to x=9.5%-39%, y=10%-82.5% so all bottles and shadows respect the 100px canvas margin without hard left-edge cropping.
Replaced parody Biscoff copy with original perfume gifting copy ('ONE SCENT SAYS IT ALL' and 'A gift everyone wants, delivered island-wide.') matching line counts and character limits.
Switched all text layers to Inter Bold (700) per the standing Canva font rule.
Mapped typography colours to Kapruka Retail Purple (#340A5C) for primary headline lines and legible lighter purple (#6B3FA0) for accent lines on the white ground.
Added the Kapruka logo in the calm top-right corner (x=71.5%, y=7.5%, top edge 101px) on a light ground.
Moved the bottom caption inward to x=9.5%, w=81%, y=89% so it sits strictly inside the 100px margin on all edges.
Removed the devil-tail arrowhead ornament per the no-ornaments rule.
